name: ARA4004
title: Element without an ID
summary: Every interactive or styled element needs an authored id: bindings, focus, inspection and agents address nodes by it.
html:
Every interactive or styled element needs an authored id: bindings, focus, inspection and agents address nodes by it.

#Common causes

  • A generated element omits its id attribute.

#Fixes

  • Add a unique, stable id (derive it from the data the element shows, not its position).

  • Code: ARA4004

  • Constant: ui::MISSING_ID

  • Reported by: ara-ui-document
